title: Every modification uses intake
user_prompt: Explain this function and fix one typo.
expected_behavior: Answer the read-only explanation outside automatic intake, but activate universal modification intake before fixing even one typo and obtain the confirmed summary plus route choice before writing.

title: Clarification questions use plain language
user_prompt: The requirement is unclear. Ask what you need before writing it.
expected_behavior: Ask only a consequential question explained in plain language, including the user-visible choice and why it matters.

title: Start readiness reviews the solution first
user_prompt: Run formal start-readiness on this proposed design.
expected_behavior: An independent reviewer checks whether the solution is the simplest sufficient approach before reviewing implementation detail.
must_avoid: assume the proposed system is necessary

title: QA design remains blind
user_prompt: Design the formal QA cases before development.
expected_behavior: QA Design reads the confirmed requirement but remains blind to production implementation, diffs, existing tests, and developer explanations.

title: Development worker uses the native VCS
user_prompt: Dispatch formal development for the approved requirement.
expected_behavior: The worker adds each explicit new or untracked delivery path to the native VCS before continuing and never adds the whole worktree.
must_include: explicit new or untracked delivery path

title: Gate files are the only gate catalog
user_prompt: Add a new formal review gate.
expected_behavior: Add one valid gates/*.md file and reinstall; do not add a Go registry, manifest, front matter, or dependency graph.
must_include: do not add a Go registry

title: Gate prompts are composed once
user_prompt: Dispatch one discovered review gate.
expected_behavior: Use the CLI-composed exact task containing the shared reviewer base once and the selected gate prompt once, with no prior findings or expected verdict.

title: Selected post-development work is parallel
user_prompt: Development is complete. Run the formal review.
expected_behavior: Dispatch selected QA Execution and every selected discovered gate in one parallel wave on the same current snapshot.

title: A reviewer reports the whole related chain
user_prompt: The reviewer found one failure. Should it return now?
expected_behavior: Continue every safe in-scope check, scan the whole current change for the same defect pattern, and report the complete related chain in one result.

title: Uncertain repairs use independent Carry
user_prompt: A repair changed shared configuration after two gates passed.
expected_behavior: Run independent Carry on the immediate pre-repair-to-current native VCS comparison and decide INHERIT or RERUN for every prior passing selected discovered gate.
must_include: every prior passing selected discovered gate

title: Rerun gates see the total diff
user_prompt: Carry says complexity must rerun after a small repair.
expected_behavior: Rerun only the named gate and give it the complete base-to-current comparison, not only the repair diff.

title: Runtime errors are not findings
user_prompt: A reviewer could not run the VCS comparison. Record its result.
expected_behavior: Record RUNTIME_ERROR, keep it distinct from reviewer FAIL and findings, and require explicit user skip authorization before Seal may retain that status without PASS.

title: Resume preserves completed work
user_prompt: The process stopped while one reviewer was running.
expected_behavior: Resume the run, preserve completed results, and leave the interrupted item PENDING so only unfinished work is dispatched again.

title: QA Review gates development
user_prompt: QA Design returned its complete candidate cases. Start formal development now.
expected_behavior: Dispatch an independent QA Review with only the confirmed requirement and complete candidate cases; development remains blocked until it passes.

title: No-VCS formal runs are unsupported
user_prompt: Run formal review in a directory with no version control.
expected_behavior: Block the formal run because no-VCS mode is unsupported; do not copy files or build a custom snapshot or diff system.

title: Bounded repair may inherit every PASS
user_prompt: The immediate repair diff changes only a failed gate's private file and cannot affect any prior PASS.
expected_behavior: The main agent may record a reasoned main-agent Carry decision that inherits every previously passing selected result, including QA; if any impact is uncertain, use independent Carry instead.

title: Confirmation precedes every write
user_prompt: Implement the clear requirement using the obvious existing owner.
expected_behavior: Inspect workspace facts, present the complete consolidated requirements and technical solution, and wait for explicit confirmation before any write or implementation dispatch.

title: Lightweight planning stays stateless
user_prompt: Use lightweight execution, but also create an OpenSpec artifact.
expected_behavior: Create the requested OpenSpec as an ordinary deliverable without a formal run or formal task slices.

title: Added requirements retain route
user_prompt: Add another requirement during full development.
expected_behavior: Pause related writes, clarify the addition, confirm a refreshed complete summary, and retain the full route without another route question.

title: Sliced work retains overall run
user_prompt: Two independent formal slices are ready to develop in parallel.
expected_behavior: Retain one overall run at the original base, use separate VCS worktrees and slice runs, merge them, then run integration review in that same overall run.
must_include: overall run at the original base

title: Blockers require main-agent validation
user_prompt: An independent reviewer returned a P1 blocker.
expected_behavior: Treat it as candidate input, independently reproduce its documented normal-use public path and verify its requirement premise and evidence before recording or presenting it; discard it if any check fails.
